settings.title: Can I modify or cancel my order after it has been placed?
settings.body: Once an order has been submitted, modifications or cancellations are not guaranteed. Orders that have entered processing or have already shipped cannot be canceled. If you need assistance, please contact our Customer Support team as soon as possible. We recommend carefully reviewing your order details before completing your purchase.

settings.title: How can I check the status of my order?
settings.body: After placing your order, you will receive an order confirmation email. Please note that an order confirmation indicates that your request has been received but does not guarantee fulfillment. Your purchase is considered confirmed once you receive a shipping confirmation email with tracking information.

settings.title: Why was my order canceled?
settings.body: Orders may be canceled due to inventory discrepancies, payment authorization issues, suspected fraudulent activity, incorrect or incomplete information, or other order verification concerns. We reserve the right to review, refuse, or cancel orders when necessary. If your order is canceled, you will receive an email notification.

settings.title: Can I combine multiple orders into one shipment?
settings.body: Orders are processed individually once submitted. We cannot guarantee that separate orders can be combined into one shipment. Additionally, orders containing multiple items may occasionally ship separately from different fulfillment locations.

settings.title: Orders & Purchasing
How long does it take for my order to ship?
settings.body: Standard orders are typically processed within 2–4 business days. During periods of high order volume, promotional events, or holidays, processing times may be extended. Once your order ships, you will receive a confirmation email with tracking information. Please note that Special Project orders and limited releases may follow different processing timelines.

settings.title: How can I track my order?
settings.body: Once your order has shipped, you will receive a shipping confirmation email containing your tracking number. Tracking information may take approximately 24–48 hours to update after shipment. You can use the tracking link provided in your email to monitor your package’s delivery progress.

settings.title: What should I do if my tracking information has not updated?
settings.body: Tracking updates may take 24–48 hours to appear after your package ships. If your tracking information has not updated or your package appears to be delayed, please contact our Customer Support team with your order number and tracking details so we can assist with reviewing the shipment.

settings.title: What happens if my package is lost, stolen, or damaged?
settings.body: If your package is marked as delivered but cannot be located, or arrives damaged, please contact our Customer Support team promptly. Claims involving lost, stolen, or damaged packages must generally be reported within 24 hours of carrier-confirmed delivery. Please include your order number, tracking information, and photos of any visible damage, if applicable. All claims are subject to review and carrier investigation.

settings.title: Shipping & Delivery
What is your return policy?
settings.body: Eligible domestic returns and exchanges must be requested within 7 days of delivery. International returns and exchanges must be requested within 10 days of delivery. Approved returns must meet our condition requirements and follow the designated return authorization process. Eligible returns are generally issued as online e-gift cards. A 20% restocking fee may apply to eligible returns when Route Protection was not selected at checkout. Please review our Return Policy for complete details and exclusions.

settings.title: Can I exchange an item for a different size?
settings.body: Exchanges are subject to eligibility and product availability. Exchanges may be accommodated for approved fulfillment errors, such as receiving an incorrect item or size, or for qualifying damaged or defective merchandise. Please contact our Customer Support team within the applicable reporting timeframe for assistance. Special Project and Final Sale items are not eligible for exchanges except as expressly provided in our policies.

settings.title: How long does it take to receive a refund?
settings.body: Once your returned item has been received, inspected, and approved, eligible return compensation is generally issued as an online e-gift card within 3–5 business days. Refunds to the original payment method are reserved for qualifying situations, such as verified fulfillment errors, damaged items, or defective merchandise. Please allow additional time for your financial institution to process any applicable refunds.

settings.title: Can I return an item purchased on sale?
settings.body: Return eligibility for promotional, discounted, and sale items depends on the applicable product restrictions. Items specifically marked as Final Sale, including Special Project items, are not eligible for returns or exchanges except in cases of verified defects or fulfillment errors, as outlined in our Terms & Conditions. Please review the product listing and Return Policy before completing your purchase.

settings.title: Returns & Exchanges
What payment methods do you accept?
settings.body: Available payment methods are displayed during checkout. By completing your purchase, you authorize the payment method provided to be charged for the order total, including applicable taxes and shipping fees. Please ensure that your payment information is accurate and that you are authorized to use the selected payment method.

settings.title: Can I use multiple discount codes on one order?
settings.body: Promotional offers and discount codes are subject to their individual terms and conditions. Unless otherwise stated, promotions cannot be combined with other discounts or promotional offers. Certain products, brands, and categories may also be excluded from promotional offers.

settings.title: Why isn’t my discount code working?
settings.body: Discount codes may have restrictions based on expiration dates, eligible products, minimum purchase requirements, or other promotional conditions. Discounts must be applied during checkout and cannot be applied retroactively to previously placed orders. Please review the terms associated with your promotion to confirm eligibility.

settings.title: Payments
How can I determine the correct size?
settings.body: We recommend reviewing the product description and any available sizing information on the product page before placing your order. Sizing may vary depending on the brand, style, and manufacturer. Please carefully review your selection before completing checkout, as size modifications cannot be guaranteed once an order has been placed.

settings.title: Are all products available online also available in stores?
settings.body: Product availability may vary between our online storefront and physical retail locations. Not all products offered online are guaranteed to be available in stores, and inventory may change frequently. We recommend contacting your local store directly to confirm product availability before visiting.

settings.title: Products & Sizing
How do I enter a raffle?
settings.body: When a raffle or exclusive release is available, visit the corresponding product or release page and follow the instructions to submit your entry through the designated EQL platform. Be sure to review all entry requirements and confirm that your contact, size, shipping, and payment information is accurate before submitting.

settings.title: Does entering a raffle guarantee that I will receive the product?
settings.body: No. Submitting a raffle entry does not guarantee selection. Winners are selected based on the applicable release terms and available inventory. Only selected participants will be charged for their purchase.

settings.title: How will I know if I have been selected as a raffle winner?
settings.body: Selected participants will receive an email notification with confirmation of their selection and a unique order number. Winner selection typically takes place within 48 hours after the raffle closes, although timing may vary. Please monitor your inbox and spam or junk folders for updates.

settings.title: When will my payment be processed if I win a raffle?
settings.body: If selected, your payment method will be automatically charged for the purchase, including applicable taxes and shipping fees. No additional confirmation is required. Please ensure that your payment information is valid and authorized before entering. If your payment is declined, your entry may be forfeited and the item offered to the next eligible participant.

settings.title: Can I change or cancel my raffle entry after submitting it?
settings.body: Raffle entries can only be canceled by the customer through the EQL platform while the launch is still open. Once the launch closes or a winning selection has been allocated, entries are final and cannot be canceled or modified. Sizes and shipping details cannot be changed after submission, so please review your information carefully before entering.

settings.title: Who should I contact if I experience an issue with my raffle entry?
settings.body: For questions or technical issues related to raffle entries, cancellations, payment failures, or entry status, please contact EQL Support directly at support@eql.com or visit eql.com/support.
